ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and identify those responsible for the misuse of funds.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the misuse of funds?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and misuse of funds in Minnesota's Medicaid program. By following the money and investigating those responsible, we can shed light on the need for increased oversight and accountability in government programs.
